en:
...Does Kokichi really plan on becoming
the blackened?

Maybe you should be more careful about
letting him into your research lab.
There are lots of poisons in there, so...

<CLT=cltMIND>What should I do?
Should I hang out with Maki for a while?

...Should we go check your research lab to see
if anyone took anything?
Also, we can stand watch in case anyone tries.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time with Maki
in my lab.
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki and I grew a little closer today.
